title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}=\left(1-2\lambdaight) {	heta}^t+\alpha \left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {	heta}^tight)ight) X_i$$

Focus on understanding each component of this equation. What does each term represent?

title: Exploring the Sigmoid Function
text:
The function sigma(z) is the sigmoid function, which is defined as:

$$sigma(z)= rac{1}{1+e^{\left(-zight)}}$$

Consider how this function behaves for different values of $$z$$. What happens when $$z$$ is very large or very small?

title: Effect of Regularization
text: The term $$\left(1-2\lambda\right) {\theta}^t$$ in the update rule is influenced by lambda, the regularization parameter. Think about how different values of lambda (positive, zero, negative) might affect this term. How does it impact the overall update?

title: Choosing $$y_i$$
text: Given $${\theta}^t=-1$$, $$X_i=5$$, lambda is unknown, and $$alpha=1$$, which value of $$y_i$$ will make $${\theta}^{t+1}$$ the most positive?\n\nConsider the impact of $$y_i$$ on the term $$\left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)\right) X_i$$.
